name: Inntal-Camping
beschreibung: The campsite Inntal-Camping is located in Flintsbach am Inn in the Austrian federal state of Tirol. The site is characterized by a quiet and well-kept atmosphere. The surroundings are shaped by forests and the course of the Inn. The surrounding mountain landscape of the Tiroler Alpen offers numerous hiking trails. In the winter season, nearby ski areas such as Skiwelt Wilder Kaiser are accessible. The amenities include sanitary facilities, electrical connections, and a supply and disposal station. Guests can expect a division into zones for motorhomes, caravans, and tents.
